build.meaning: Original approved collection build/pins unchanged. Separate compilation/review/approval required before execution.

receiptMeaning: Existing Funding payout receipt key and EVM transaction Receipt only. No consumption Receipt/terminal, user withdrawal, Held release or PnL profit payout.
targetPrecision: Pinned custom error selector and deepest reverting contract via existing debug_traceCall/debug_traceTransaction. Source lines document static branch analysis, not a claimed runtime program-counter/source-map proof.

snapshotLinkage.blockTag: Every eth_call and eth_getCode uses the observation block number; block hash rechecked
snapshotLinkage.transaction: Adjacent execution block, parentHash equals before hash, exactly one transaction, from/to/input/status/Receipt/raw log linkage, after block equals execution block
snapshotLinkage.rejection: Inherited static and mined rollback assertions retained; both receipt keys and authorization included
